name: Hunter
lore: Tactical marksman and beastmaster: commands a faithful beast companion to intercept hits, arms defensive traps, and snipes from safety.

resource.name: Guardian Pet
resource.tip: Your pet intercepts single-target attacks aimed at you and claws enemies each turn. Keep it healthy with Mend Pet.
resource.rules: Your Pet acts as a Guardian that intercepts single-target attacks aimed at you. Arm traps before enemy attacks strike, and use ranged shots to pick off threats from safety.

archetypes.name: Beast Mastery
archetypes.text: Your pet does the work: buff it, heal it, and let it act twice.

archetypes.name: Marksmanship
archetypes.text: Mark the target, then hit it with big ranged shots and Volley.

archetypes.name: Survival
archetypes.text: Traps, slows and stuns: control the fight, then finish with melee bites.

relics.name: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers
relics.text: Start each combat with the enemy Marked 3.

relics.name: Giantstalker's Helmet
relics.text: At the start of each turn, your pet attacks once more.
